title: Enabling simulations of helium bubble nucleation and growth: A strategy for interatomic potentials
role: Reference observations only. Human must select fit/validation roles and tolerances; FS baseline values are not DFT targets.
conditions: H-free FCC Pd unless stated. Paper PBE DFT uses a cubic 108-Pd cell, >=6x6x6 k mesh, 500 eV cutoff, 0.2 eV Methfessel-Paxton width, force tolerance <0.001 eV/Angstrom and relaxed cell. Paper molecular statics uses 5x5x5 FCC cells (6x6x6 for rocksalt).

additional_validation.He_equation_of_state: Paper Fig. 5 and Section V.B: fluid EOS, 300 K, pressures 1-22 kbar. Pure-He behavior must be validated separately from gas interactions in metals.
